page.layout: One printed page with a woodcut; running head and heading at the top; woodcut of a bust of Terminus with its plinth inscription in the centre; a small margin note at the right ("NVLLI") and a sidenote at the left ("CONCEDO"); the text of the page is only the title lines and the caption at the foot. Left edge shows the facing page's margin (not transcribed).
page.notes: The woodcut shows a bust of an old bearded man with the plinth inscribed TERMINVS; the Greek line is rendered as printed in the scan but its exact letters are uncertain. Marginal word "CONCEDO" at the left edge, and "NVLLI" at the right, are side notes; the left-margin fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. The bottom "ii 2" and the signature-like mark are doubtful.
